raw_text: People's Defence Force units launched their largest coordinated offensive in Sagaing Region's western corridor near the India-Myanmar border. The attacks targeted at least five military outposts between Tamu and Khampat, with resistance forces claiming to have captured significant weapons stockpiles. The junta responded with airstrikes on civilian areas near Kalay, displacing approximately 5,000 people towards the Indian border.
clean_text: PDF launches largest Sagaing offensive targeting five military outposts near India border. Junta airstrikes displace 5,000 towards Indian border.
